newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA TO INVESTIGATE REFEREE IN BRIBERY CASE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA TO INVESTIGATE REFEREE IN BRIBERY CASE.

text.p: FIFA said they would investigate Swiss referee Kurt Roethlisbeger who on Thursday lost his appeal to UEFA against a life ban for attempted bribery.

Roethlisberger, once recognised as one of soccer's top officials, was suspended by UEFA after they found he solicited a bribe to fix a European Champions' League match between Grasshopper Zurich and Auxerre on October 30.
But the ban extends only to UEFA-related activities and does not apply worldwide.
UEFA, European soccer's governing body, plan to forward the findings of their investigation to world body FIFA who will examine the case.
FIFA said in a statement on Friday Roethlisberger could face a worldwide ban if their findings concurred with those of UEFA.
